artDirection.backgroundPrompt:
A stylized Counter-Strike operative character captured in a dynamic tactical pose, gripping an AK-47 assault rifle with both hands in a ready position. The character wears tactical gear including a dark ballistic vest, combat helmet with night vision goggles mounted on top, and fingerless gloves. Dynamic low-angle perspective looking up at the operative, creating a heroic larger-than-life presence. The figure is positioned center-right of the canvas, leaving the left side open for text overlay. Bold solid color fills with dramatic cast shadows - no gradients or soft shading. The illustration style matches CB's bold vector aesthetic with clean sharp edges suitable for compositing. Color palette incorporates brand colors: deep purple (#8D52DA) for the tactical vest, orange (#FF6B2F) accent details on the weapon and gear, dark navy shadows, white highlights on metallic surfaces. Energy lines and geometric fragments suggest competitive intensity radiating from behind the character. The operative's stance conveys readiness and precision - weight balanced, weapon held professionally, eyes focused ahead through tactical goggles. Clean crisp edges throughout, no fuzzy details, premium esports tournament aesthetic. NO text, NO logos, NO background elements beyond the character and subtle geometric energy effects.

From vault-illustrations-illustration-01: Borrow the clean vector illustration style with dramatic shadow casting, realistic proportions, and motion-focused composition with strong athletic energy. From vault-illustrations-illustration-03: Adopt the bold graphic vector art style with simplified forms, clean lines, and minimal shading against contrasting backgrounds - translate this aesthetic to tactical/esports theme. From vault-illustrations-illustration-06: Use the flat design vector approach with clean geometric shapes, bold color blocking, and contemporary sports graphic style - apply to gaming character design. From vault-previous-posts-slide-3-twitter-new: Reference the flat illustration style with clean lines, dramatic angular elements, and modern esports aesthetic - particularly the character pose and competitive gaming mood.
